Privacy Explained

What does "Ad blocker detected" mean?

You have probably seen sites ask you to disable your ad blocker or to whitelist this website. In this guide we explain how that detection works.

Why sites say "Please disable your ad blocker"

Publishers rely on advertising revenue. Some show a message like "We noticed you're using an ad blocker" and ask you to turn off ad blocking.

Our view: we don't mind ad blockers. Browse however you like.

Tip: Brave Shields lets you change protection per site.
